$comment: The genius in play: its orders, how it fights, how it falls, what the Tally counts from a fight, and how big it stands. The rules of its growth (instars, Resonance, shadows, slots) are in rules.json; the Reading's numbers in reading.json. Every number here is a designer's knob.

orders.name: Guard
orders.text: Stays at your side and takes the hit you did not see.

orders.name: Hunt
orders.text: Goes for the foe you are locked on to, with blows of its own.

orders.name: Hold
orders.text: Takes a place and keeps it: what comes onto its ground is struck and slowed, and you are guarded while you stand there.

orders.name: Free
orders.text: Its own judgment: it guards, hunts or holds as it has learned you fight.

free.$comment: Free chooses among the other orders every `think` seconds, by a score for each: its base, plus each weight times what it measures (0 to 1). hurtShare, parryShare: of the blows that came at its partner over their life together and in this fight, the share taken and the share parried. lowHealth: how far its partner is below half health. close, far: the share of its partner's hits landed close and far (the Tally's range line). open: the foe's guard is down. post: the fight has a post. pack: more than one foe stands. It changes its mind only for a score better by `margin`. why: what it says when it chooses, by the weight that decided it.

why.post: there is a post to keep

orders.name: Duet
orders.text: Joins your Pattern: the chain doubles, and the payout with it.

byExpression.$comment: How each kind of genius hunts: damage and interval multipliers.

fall.$comment: A fallen genius lies until the post, extraction or the hearth; in the practice yard it gets up after roomRecoverSeconds.

tally.$comment: Where a hit lands, in metres: closer than close is close; closer than mid is mid; past it is far.

stages.$comment: Where a genius is on its line, in the player's words (docs/genius-lines.md), by its form's level on the tree: the Baby is everyone's before the rite; a Starter is a base's settled form, a Path one of its three paths, an Advancement a prong, a Final a finish. plural is how the page counts what comes next.

size.$comment: How tall a genius stands, by instar, in metres: the young of its kind at the First Form, grown at the Third (a wolf at the shoulder and head), and at Apex taller than its partner.

progression.$comment: How a genius's progress shows between Readings (docs/genius-progression.md). growth: how far it grows toward the next instar's size before the Reading comes (0 none, 1 all the way). molt: its readiness for the next Reading (0 to 1: the share of the minimum days lived, 1 once the milestone is reached too) at which the molt lines begin to show along its body, and their strength when the Reading is due.

ages.$comment: A genius is a living thing with an age: each instar is one. The age shapes the body (data/genius-bodies.json, ages: the young have large heads and short legs, the great are deep in the chest) and, once it has finished its tree, names it. word is how its page says it. name: what a finished form is called at that age ({name} is the form's: a Great Pack-mother, a Pack-mother of the Line).

presence.$comment: What the later instars add that can be seen from across a yard. lines: seams of steady light along the body (0 to 1). mantle: blades of light standing behind its head and shoulders, this many. ground: a light under it in its partner's Shape colour, this strong.

echo.$comment: The echo: what a genius's growth writes onto its partner's body, instar by instar (World.features_of; the features are in data/people-features.json). all: for every genius. byExpression: a piece worn at the throat or over the heart from the Third Form, in the genius's own coat colour, by what the genius is. grow: how large that piece is at each instar. field: how strongly the field shows under the skin, by instar, as a multiple.

fight.$comment: The genius fights as what it is (docs/genius-combat.md). Its moves come from the kind of body it has (data/genius-bodies.json, kind), its Expression and the features it carries, never from its form's name, so a new form gets moves by what it is made of. Its age (progression.ages) says how much of that it can do yet. Its order says where it stands and what it attends to. Damage numbers are multiples of the Hunt order's damage.

speed.$comment: How fast it crosses the ground, metres a second. An object is worn or carried: it is where its partner is.

strike.$comment: What its plain blow is called, by kind.

moves.$comment: when: hunt (on the foe it hunts, or the foe on the ground it holds), guard (while it guards), any. passive: always so, no wait. wait: seconds before it can again. will: what it costs it.

hamstring.name: Hamstring
hamstring.text: It comes in low at the foe's legs: a blow, and the foe is slowed.

stoop.name: Stoop
stoop.text: It climbs and comes down on the foe: one heavy blow, and then it must climb again.

shot.name: A shot
shot.text: It fires from where it stands.

debt.name: Mark a debt
debt.text: It writes the foe a debt. If the foe strikes its partner while it stands, the foe pays.

lay.name: Lay itself down
lay.text: It lays itself on the ground under the foe: what stands there burns, slows or strikes weakly, by what it is made of.

light.name: Light the ground
light.text: It lights the ground: its partner reads every wind-up sooner, and the moment to parry is longer.

call.name: Call it
call.text: It calls the foe's next strike onto itself and takes it out of its own Will.

brace.name: Brace
brace.text: It sets itself: guarding costs it less, it is ready again sooner, and a blow it guards cannot fell it.

with.name: Strike with you
with.text: It is in your hand or on your back: every third blow of yours it adds one of its own.

lays.$comment: What laying itself down does, by the first of its features that says (layBy), burning if none does. burn: damage a second (a multiple of the Hunt's). chill: the foe's time runs at this. dark: the foe's blows from inside it land for this.

ages.$comment: What its age lets it do. strike: its plain blow, as a multiple (a young one's is a nip). nip: every so many nips the foe flinches, for this long. moves: how many of its moves it has yet. wait: its waits are this much longer or shorter. power: its moves are this strong. great: it has the move only the great have, at this strength.

great.$comment: The move only the great and the Apex have, on a long wait: one that changes the fight when it lands. By kind, or by Expression where the Expression says more. stagger: the foe is thrown down (its guard with it) and struck. ward: the next blows at its partner are turned. double: for a while every blow of its partner's lands twice. flood: it lays itself over the whole ground. reckon: the foe is struck and written a debt at once.

equipment.$comment: The equipment geniuses (owner, 2026-11-12): a genius held, carried or worn is a living thing in that shape, and it is sized to the hand at every stage. It does not grow as a creature does: what a stage gives it is secondary characteristics (eyes, sinew, breath, colour), never size. categories: the three kinds, in the player's words, and the bases sorted into them (a base in none is a companion). This is a name over the types of data/genius-types.json, which still say what each does in a fight. hand: for each base, how long it is in the hand, in the game's units (a person stands about 2.4, a hand is 0.26 long). measure says what is measured: box (the longest side of the whole thing as it is held) or bulk (the breadth of a glove, from its body's bulk; its long is then counted in hands, and 1 is a hand). Every form is brought into long, give or take tolerance, whatever stage it is: a Final is never larger than its Starter by more than that (game/tests/check_items.gd fails on it). most: with what it has grown, nothing of it reaches further than this. afloat: how large it floats at its partner's side against its size in the hand (1: the same thing, let go). augments: the proof of one worn on the body (docs/genius-types.md, 'Augments'); nothing here is a rule of a fight.

arms.name: Arms
arms.text: A living thing in the shape of a weapon or a shield.

regalia.name: Regalia
regalia.text: A living thing in the shape of an instrument of office: a lamp, a glass, a bell.

augments.name: Augments
augments.text: A living thing that is part of you: wings at your back, a tail, a light under the skin.

augments.$comment: Living wings, the proof (tools/blender/augment_wings.py; game/scripts/genius/augment.gd; look at one with --study --augment=wings --stage=0..4 --body=<person>). bone: the bone of its partner's rig it rides; at: where from that bone, in its partner's own left, up and front; madeFor: the breadth of shoulders its model was made on (it is made broader or narrower with its partner, within reason). stages: what each stage shows, for the people who make it; it is the same size at all five. None of this is a rule of a fight.

stages.shows: Down on the arm of the wing, and bare quills where the flight feathers will be.
The quills have their vanes: plain flight feathers. An eye opens at each wrist, and blinks.
A second row over the first, banded dark. Sinews of the field down the arm, breathing.
Coverts over the shoulder. An eye of the field on every third feather, as on a moth's wing.
Every feather edged with the field. Strings of sinew from the last feathers. A third eye between the wings, and gills at their roots that breathe.

renamed.$comment: A base that was taken out of the tree and what stands in its place (the Coat became the Living Armor on 2026-11-12: nothing is worn any more). A saved genius of the old base is read as the new one (Genius.from_dict): bases maps a base's id, forms each form's id (a hybrid's two bases and its form alike), silhouettes the body it wore. It keeps its name, its look, its age, its Seed-mark and what it had kept; what it is made of is the new form's.
